independenceStatement: This reviewer did not author or modify the reviewed production UI, validation harness, remediation, or immutable browser collection. The reviewer wrote only the assigned remediation reviewer-report.json and reviewer-report.md and did not touch the prior FAIL review, production UI, tests, collection inputs, frozen design artifacts, specifications, task checkboxes, owner artifacts, Git staging, or commits.

remediationChecks.check: Migration.excalidraw displays the required visible unsaved marker

remediationChecks.check: Clean Tabs do not receive false unsaved markers
remediationChecks.expected: Architecture.excalidraw and Research.excalidraw remain clean with zero visible unsaved markers.
remediationChecks.actual: The fixed actual capture shows no marker on the two clean Tabs, and the v3 collector records marker count 0 for each.

remediationChecks.expected: The unsaved state uses a visible marker plus accessible text; the component contract does not prescribe an exact marker color.

visualChecks.expected: Compact Sidebar and Back icon controls remain at the far-left of the top shell layer.

visualChecks.check: Restored Tabs preserve the approved visible state cues

visualChecks.actual: The remediated capture visibly preserves the active Tab hierarchy and the single Migration unsaved marker without false markers on the clean Tabs.

visualChecks.expected: The app-owned recovery status is present below the top shell with restrained emphasis and an accurate three-drawing count.
visualChecks.actual: Recovered · 3 drawings restored appears at the approved left/top position with the expected quiet panel treatment and clear text hierarchy.

visualChecks.actual: The Light shell surfaces, dividers, Tabs, and recovery notice preserve the approved restrained hierarchy outside the SDK-owned interior.
